description_for_human: Read the user's Outlook calendar to surface today's meetings, upcoming events, and meeting details including agendas and Teams join links.

functions.name: getTodaysMeetings
functions.description: Returns calendar events for a given time window (startDateTime to endDateTime), including subject, start/end times, attendees, Teams join link, and any agenda in the invite body.

startDateTime.description: ISO 8601 start date-time for the query window (e.g. 2025-06-10T00:00:00).

endDateTime.description: ISO 8601 end date-time for the query window (e.g. 2025-06-10T23:59:59).

functions.name: getMeetingDetails
functions.description: Returns full details for a specific meeting by its event ID, including the body/agenda, attendees, attachments, and Teams meeting link.

eventId.description: The unique identifier of the calendar event.

functions.name: createMeeting
functions.description: Creates a new calendar event / Teams meeting with the specified subject, attendees, start time, end time, and optional agenda body.

body.description: Optional agenda or meeting notes to include in the invite body.

isTeamsMeeting.description: When true, a Microsoft Teams online meeting link is automatically added. Default is true.
